run_laikago_simulation: run the pybullet laikago quadruped robot simulation with GUI and self-collision enabled
load_laikago_urdf: load the laikago_toes.urdf model into pybullet with a fixed base disabled
set_collision_filter_pairs: enable collision filtering between lower leg joint pairs on the quadruped robot
playback_joint_trajectory: read joint angle data from data1.txt and playback via position control in pybullet
control_joints_interactively: use pybullet debug parameters to interactively control laikago joint positions in real time
